title: mcpx: complete gopls worktree live proof after PR #8049
body:
Follow-up to the incomplete live-workspace proof in #961 after the configuration flip in PR #8049.

## Evidence

- PR #8049 changed `gopls-mcp-server` to `mcpx.scope = "worktree"` in the fleet config.
- #961's acceptance requires three live checks: `go_package_api` on a module path returns the real API promptly; the same proof from a linked worktree is rooted in that worktree; and two callers in distinct checkouts have distinct gopls instances in `mcpx status`.
- PR #8049's body and issue comment #6780423113 state that these checks were not run because the daemon still loaded the pre-merge Nix-store config. Issue #961 was closed on 2026-11-10 before the live proof was recorded.
- A current issue search found no separate tracker for these three checks. Lane 2 has the closure pointer on #13871 comment 7162914420; this issue tracks the executable remainder without reopening #961.

## Scope

Revalidate the currently running mcpx daemon and complete the three #961 live checks. If the daemon is still using the pre-merge config, update it through the supported config generation/deployment path and restart via the managed service path before running the checks; do not hand-edit an ephemeral config. Record the daemon version/config state, prompt outcome, linked-worktree root, and the two distinct instances observed in `mcpx status`.

If prerequisites prevent the live proof, record the exact blocker and route a separately scoped activation fix. Do not report a proof from an unconnected CI runner.

## Acceptance

- `go_package_api` returns the module's real API from the main checkout.
- The same prompt from a linked worktree returns that worktree's API/root.
- Two callers from different checkouts produce distinct worktree-scoped gopls instances in `mcpx status`.
- Evidence names the daemon/config generation in use and identifies the command/session used for each check.
